votes.motion: Council Member Shelton motioned to approve the November 7, 2023 City Council Study Meeting minutes, November 7, 2023 City Council Meeting minutes, and November 8, 2023 City Council Strategic Planning Meeting minutes as published. Council Member Council Member Harris seconded the motion; vote was unanimous in favor
Council Member Zander motioned to amend tonight’s agenda and remove Item J, as the training was done during the previous Study Session Meeting and has been completed
Council Member Marlor motioned to approve Resolution R2023-56, Requesting Recertification of the City of South Jordan Municipal Justice Court
Council Member Marlor motioned to adjourn the City Council Meeting
